The court directed the applications to be numbered and listed for hearing.

title: India's GDP grows 7.8% in Q1: Factors powering the economy despite global turmoil
description: In the first quarter, India showcased impressive economic resilience with a remarkable 7.8% GDP growth. The surge was notably driven by a surge in domestic demand and the services sector. Additionally, investment activity picked up pace, enhancing the overall economic landscape. This achievement stands out amid global geopolitical tensions and market fluctuations, reinforcing India's status as the fastest-growing major economy in the world.

title: 'Killed her, then went to sleep': Chilling calm of nurse killer baffles cops
description: A bike mechanic was arrested for raping and strangling a nurse in Pahadishareef.  He allegedly watched the woman for a month before entering her room through a window.  The accused returned to his garage and slept after committing the crime.  Mobile data and forensic evidence helped investigators crack the difficult case.  Police are checking the accused's criminal record in Bihar.

title: Scientists lowered Ontario lake pH for 17 years; trout still haven't recovered
description: A groundbreaking 17-year study on Lake 223 in Ontario revealed a complex response to acid rain. While the water chemistry has recovered since the experiment ended, the ecosystem is lagging behind. Fish numbers have not rebounded as hoped, with growth rates remaining low. This underscores the vital message that true ecological healing involves much more than merely restoring chemical balance.

description: In a remarkable real estate move, Meta's Mark Zuckerberg and his wife Priscilla Chan have purchased the enchanting Strancally Castle in County Waterford, encompassing 440 acres. This magnificent estate will serve as their residence during visits to Ireland, where Meta’s global operations are anchored. The castle boasts a rich heritage, thanks to a 25-year restoration by its former owners.
